verdict.rationale: Docusign offers configurable CLM workflows, conditional logic in web forms, and IAM-triggered workflow actions via its Claude/MCP connector, and dynamically adjusts verification based on automated risk rules — all of which show rule-based automation triggered by events. However, none of the evidence details a general-purpose, user-definable rules/event engine (e.g. 'if X happens, do Y') beyond specific pre-built product features. Missing for 10: a documented generic rule-builder or event-trigger API, independent hands-on validation of automation reliability, and detail on how broadly 'any event' can be configured as a trigger.
